name: webbed-wasm-tests
description: Dependencies for the duckdb-wasm live load test (load_test.cjs). The static check (check_wasm_imports.mjs / run_wasm_checks.sh) needs no dependencies. The engine pin must match the DuckDB the extension is built against: 1.33.1-dev121.0 is built from duckdb commit 8d78114e90a53823803660bf821f6073ac87da8c, the v2.0.1 tag commit this repo pins (verified 2026-11-23 by grepping its duckdb-base.wasm and duckdb-threads.wasm for 8d78114e90). The `latest` tag, dev57.0, is still a v1.5.4-era engine. Bump in lockstep with the duckdb submodule.
